object: The composition unit in Hoard: a bounded scope that groups cards into a publishable, navigable whole. A holon defines its membership (which cards belong), its expression preference (which version of shared cards to show), and its ordering (how to arrange them).  Holons are Koestler's holons made concrete — simultaneously autonomous wholes and parts of a larger hord.
